scope: Original static, whole living animal for a Cambrian marine region of a prehistoric 3D world. Species-informed reconstruction, not a fossil slab, museum mount, scan, exact individual or animated animal.

scientific_limits.en: Compression fossils do not preserve life volume or color. This revision adopts the 2023 interpretation of three post-antennal head-limb pairs and nine trunk-limb pairs; the strongest direct new head evidence is from S. minor, supported by reinterpretation of S. inexpectans specimens. Abdominal counts of two and three remain published alternatives: r001 explicitly follows the two-sclerite Burgess Shale interpretation in Zacaï et al. 2016. Exact limb joint and gill-filament counts, shell thickness, soft tissues, posture and palette are simplified or inferred, not fossil-exact.

taxon.group: Artiopoda; relationship to Vicissicaudata follows the cited 2023 studies, not a definitive phylogenetic claim
taxon.age_context: Cambrian, Miaolingian Series, Wuliuan Stage; Burgess Shale context, approximately 505 million years ago in museum usage
anatomical_anchors: ROM 61118, complete specimen, museum length 97 mm
USNM 57487, lectotype; the unretouched fossil photograph is primary, historical retouch is not
USNM 269165 and ROM 63377, dorsal/ventral specimens in Zacaï 2016 Figure 1
ROM 63380, lateral specimen in Zacaï 2016 Figure 2
taxon.individual_scope: Generic non-juvenile interpretation, no exact sex, individual identity or complete ontogenetic diagnosis.

scale.basis: Chosen construction dimensions, not a scan or a measurement of one individual. Zhu 2023 Table 3 reports S. inexpectans body lengths 85, 94 and 98 mm with widths 46, 54 and 59 mm; these support hand-scale proportions. Height and antenna reach are artistic reconstruction. Record both body-only and complete exported bounds; do not normalize the GLB to gallery size.

coordinates.origin: Midline at center of intended leg-contact footprint, lowest exported point at Z=0; identity root. World placement uses the recorded contact offset, not a baked seabed.

pose.description: Quiet seabed-ready stance: low, slightly vaulted body; paired legs flexed below and slightly outside plate margins; antennae project forward and outward without crossing; narrow rear and tail fan extend behind. No raised threatening claws, prey, supports, sediment or water in the export.
pose.interpretation: Static placement pose, not proof of gait or swimming motion.

concept.reason: Full museum reconstruction, two full fossil images and published dorsal/ventral and lateral fossil figures were inspected. These suffice for an original structural brief; no extra generated concept is needed. Older art guides only broad volume, not superseded appendage counts.

morphology.obligation: Build a low oval body with nine separately readable, overlapping trunk tergites. Width grows through the anterior trunk then narrows posteriorly; pleural margins sweep back. Preserve the abrupt transition to a much narrower cylindrical abdomen, not a uniform oval pill.
morphology.basis: Observed fossil silhouette and published dorsal/lateral interpretations.

morphology.obligation: Short broad head shield with a rounded anterior rim and lateral notches. A pair of stalked eyes and a pair of slender segmented antennae emerge at the notches. Keep the head lower and shorter than the broad trunk; do not add radiodont frontal graspers.
morphology.basis: Named museum fossils and Figure 1; exact antenna length and minute segmentation are not prescribed.

morphology.obligation: Use three paired post-antennal cephalic limbs beneath the head and nine paired trunk limbs, one pair per tergite. Include a modest ventral hypostome and mouth region. Each trunk limb has a jointed inner walking branch and an outer lamellar branch; preserve attachment and separation instead of dangling disconnected rods.
morphology.basis: Explicit selected 2023 genus-level restoration. Do not silently reuse ROM’s older zero-head-limb or four-walking/five-swimming recipe. Micro-CT evidence in S. minor is comparative, not a scan of this species.

morphology.obligation: Show robust basal limb regions with restrained inward-facing gnathobasic teeth near the ventral midline, tapering jointed legs with terminal claw-like tips, and thin overlapping gill/exopod blades. Simplify repeated fine structures without claiming an exact joint, spine or lamella count. No exposed internal digestive organs.
morphology.basis: Functional anatomy and selected revised appendage organization; extent of cephalic gill branches remains interpretive.

morphology.obligation: For r001 use two narrower limbless abdominal sclerites, followed by a central triangular telson and paired broad lateral flaps. Telson and flaps form a distinct three-part fan with physical thickness and readable roots. Do not substitute a long stinger, fish fin or one solid triangle.
morphology.basis: Two-sclerite interpretation in Figures 1–2, explicitly one published alternative to three rings. Do not copy S. minor’s one-ring, shorter-telson form.

geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings, not targets. Spend geometry on shell overlap, notches, tapered antennae, complete bilateral limb organization and tail roots. Group repeated export geometry by material as needed while preserving editable semantic parts; do not omit legs merely to fit primitive count.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original muted warm umber/grey shell, slightly lighter ventral limbs and gill blades, dark eyes. All colors are artistic. Portable Principled/glTF materials; no reference image pixels.
surface_profile.normal_style: Broad coherent low-poly planes, restrained shell vaulting and thin beveled plate rims; no random facet colors or jagged noise.

art_direction.construction: Original lofted shield, shell bands, abdomen and tail. Real volumetric undersides and connected articulated limbs, not a textured silhouette or fossil-shaped flat slab. Keep some space under shell margins so the whole animal reads from side and perspective.
excluded_details: generic lobster claws or trilobite pygidium
scenery, labels, cameras or lights inside export

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect cheap clay/silhouette views first. Resolve nine-plate rhythm, full limb attachments, eye/antenna notches and narrow rear/tail separation before polish. If a ventral root cannot be judged, inspect that specific area privately, not an automatic extra final-view set.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of the exact delivered GLB; preview may reuse perspective image bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default. Only add a private diagnostic for a named unresolved defect.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website camera/renderer unverified. Keep canonical QA directions; do not claim site compatibility or produce 768x432 derivatives in preparation.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependency. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

world_use.role: Hand-sized mobile sea-floor carnivore/potential scavenger in a Burgess Shale-inspired Cambrian marine region.
world_use.placement: Separate animal; world controls substrate contact, water placement and motion. Feeding evidence supports small invertebrate consumption, not a scripted attack. Do not imply coexistence with Devonian or Mesozoic animals, or combine distinct Cambrian localities without checking.
world_use.integration_boundary: No rig, locomotion, collision proxy, LOD or populated-world performance promised. World scene integration remains a separate verified step.

acceptance_obligations: Four exact-GLB views must visibly satisfy the named morphology; inspect ventral limb attachment geometry directly if canonical images hide it.
Validate real meter scale, counts, portability, source reopening, official Khronos result and exact-GLB parsing with hash-bound evidence.
Keep generator, parameters and relative dependencies; perform two isolated deterministic semantic rebuilds when model work starts.
Fresh independent visual/factual/specification review is separate from maker technical checks. Maker decision stays PENDING until independent review.
Keep GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment UNKNOWN until separately evidenced. This brief authorizes no upload, Git push, merge or deployment.

original_inventory_identity.selection: Preserves the planned broad overlapping trunk, abrupt narrow abdominal rings and tail paddles. Narrows genus to Burgess Shale S. inexpectans using named sources.
